profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Microsoft
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer focused on building reliable backend services, cross-product APIs, and seamless generative AI integrations. Having spent my career working on products at massive scale, I specialize in taking complex technical requirements and turning them into stable, well-architected user features.

My approach combines disciplined engineering with cross-team collaboration. I excel in high-velocity environments where requirements aren't always fully defined, using a proactive, iterative approach to prototype features, identify architectural gaps early, and de-risk technical uncertainty. Whether I am owning the end-to-end rollout of new AI-driven user experiences, designing robust data pipelines, or coordinating critical security infrastructure across organizational boundaries, I focus on system reliability and developer velocity.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Improved system reliability for the core Copilot Notebooks platform, identifying and fixing codebase vulnerabilities to ensure consistent uptime.
• Designed and built the Loop API integration for OneNote, allowing users to seamlessly create, favorite, and manage Copilot Notebooks.
• Mentored and onboarded partner team developers to the codebase, speeding up cross-team integration and feature delivery.
• Integrated AI assistance into the on-call monitoring pipeline, automating early incident response and reducing the time needed to resolve active alerts.
• Led the initial setup and architecture of the Copilot Notebooks backend services, establishing clean infrastructure boundaries from the ground up.
• Led a cross-team security initiative for OneNote services, coordinating multi-team rollouts and fixing complex authentication and registration bugs between middleware services.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Designed and built the user telemetry system for OneNote's Copilot features, ensuring comprehensive data tracking across all client entry points and user interfaces.
•  Collaborated with central data teams to integrate local telemetry pipelines into company-wide reporting systems, unblocking high-level product analytics and usage tracking.
•  Owned the end-to-end implementation, testing, and rollout of OneNote’s inaugural AI features, including text rewriting, task generation, and document summarization.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Technical coordinator: Researching front facing tickets and performing work estimation and planning processes accordingly.
• Individual technical contributor: Implementing UI/UX design for edge case user interactions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Supported the Student Administration system at UNF, a college of 16,000 students
•	Led conversions of legacy Self-Service 8 applications within the student system to Self-Service 9
•	Diagnosed end user issues to make feature changes in line with their needs, overall application priorities, and production release standards
•	Organized user testing for features changes and conversions
•	Supported the integration of Parchment into UNF’s EDI and academic credentials system

positions.title: Development Intern
positions.description:
•	Learned new languages (C#, Javascript) and systems (Active Directory) on the job with minimal oversight
•	Architected and developed a new employee directory system which has moved into production
•	Developed on all levels of the stack: front end development, API endpoints, and database level coding
•	Went through a rigorous code review process and learned how feedback is given and incorporated in a pre-production environment
•	Presented the final product to senior executives including the CIO and CEO through a brief overview coupled with a product demo and Q&A session

positions.title: Java Development Intern
positions.description:
•	Maintained and updated an enterprise scale program that serves 30,000+ vendors across North Carolina
•	Designed and implemented unit tests on a difficult code base dating back to the early 2000s 
•	Gained experience working in both waterfall and agile development cycles
•	Handled service tickets that required me to work on different sections of the program, providing valuable experience on how to learn on the fly and familiarize myself quickly with new code.

positions.title: Computer Science Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
●	Served as a Teaching Assistant for a computer science course with over 500 students
●	Supervised two lab periods, fielding questions and explaining concepts to 40+ students
●	Held weekly office hours open to all Introduction to Software Design students to assist with assignments, course content, code reviews, and any other aspects of the curriculum
●	Solved and explained defects or logic errors in students’ code during both lab periods and office hours
●	Explained computer science topics to students using analogies and other techniques to simplify concepts and enhance their understanding

positions.title: Quality Assurance Tester
positions.description:
● Rehired based on experience and assistance on Cloudbuilt Downloadable Content (DLC) (see below)
● Provided insight to the developers from an expert player’s perspective building on experiences from the
previous release
● Documented findings and issues to be addressed in the developers’ overhaul of the original Cloudbuilt
